snippet.title: Edge of Memories - Narrative Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Journey to the ravaged land of Avaris where a mysterious plague called the Corrosion has mutated everything it touches. You play as Eline, a nomadic Soul Whisperer who discovers a dark power within herself that might be the key to ending the extinction-threat the world faces. Battle monstrous foes in real-time combat, unleash devastating combos, ride a loyal nek­aroo through stunning and changing landscapes, and fight alongside allies to restore hope in a dying world. Developed by Midgar Studio and published by Nacon, Edge of Memories is coming in 2026 to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series
